title: Mexican Battered Fish Tacos
description: Crispy fried fish in a Greek-style batter with a side of tangy slaw, served in a warm taco shell.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, mix together the flour, baking powder, and salt.
2. Add the Greek yogurt and mix until a smooth batter forms.
3. Add the egg and mix until well combined.
4. Dip each fish fillet into the batter, coating both sides evenly.
5. Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
6. Fry the battered fish for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and cooked through.
7. Meanwhile, warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
8. Assemble the tacos by placing a piece of fried fish onto a warmed tortilla, followed by a spoonful of Greek salad mix and a squeeze of lime juice.
